name: rare-bird-dashboard-root
description: Root project for Rare Bird Dashboard

scripts.build: npm run prisma:generate --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run prisma:migrate --prefix backend
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
scripts.typecheck:vercel: npm run prisma:generate --prefix backend && npm run typecheck:vercel --prefix backend
